累.def: tired; to accumulate; to involve; bother, nuisance

ety.hint: Simplified form of 纍; growing silk 糸 in the fields 畾; 畾 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 纍: 糸 (silk) for the meaning plus 畾 as the sound, cut down to one 田 (field). First 'rope, to bind', then to pile up and be worn out; the 'tired from field work' story is folk etymology.

累.name: tired

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 亏 (a form of 于) as the sound: stagnant, dirty water, filth.

替.def: to change, to replace, to substitute for

ety.hint: One man 夫 replacing another; 日 provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Two standing people 竝 over 曰: two figures changing places, to replace. The people became 夫夫 (two men) and 曰 looks like 日.

替.name: substitute

origin.says: 罒 (net) for the meaning plus 者 as the sound: to place and arrange, as in a net of posts; hence a government office, and to sign one's name.
歹 (death, bones) for the meaning plus 朱 as the sound: first to kill or cut off, then 'set apart', hence different, special.

隐.def: to hide, to conceal; secret, hidden

ety.hint: A place 阝 to hide when worried 急

origin.says: Simplified from 隱: 阝 (hill) for the meaning plus 㥯 (careful) as the sound, hidden behind a hill. The simplified form turns 㥯 into a shape like 急 (urgent), which here carries no meaning.

隐.name: concealed

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 良 (good) as the sound: a young woman, later mother. It also replaces the old form 孃.

伊.def: he she; this, that; used in transliterations

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 尹 (official) as the sound: a pronoun 'he, she, that one'; now mostly used to spell foreign names.

伊.name: that person

origin.says: 亻 (person) plus 火 (fire), the sound, also read as people sharing one cooking fire: a companion. Simplification used this existing form for 夥 (many, partners), built from 果 (fruit) and 多 (many).
Stands for 煙: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 垔 as the sound: smoke. Simplification used the old variant 烟, whose sound part is the simpler 因 (cause). Now also tobacco, cigarettes.

ety.hint: Two 两 carts 车; 两 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 輛: 車 (vehicle) for the meaning plus 兩 (two, a pair) as the sound, perhaps the pair of wheels: a counter for vehicles. Both parts are simplified, to 车 and 两.
厷 (upper arm) as the sound plus 隹 (bird) for the meaning: a male bird, hence male, powerful, a hero.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 平 (level) as the sound: an old name for a floating plant. In simplified writing it also replaces 蘋 (艹 plant + 頻 as the sound), used in the word for apple.

ety.hint: Two shoots 弓 dying to frost 冫

origin.says: Two copies of a bent shape, each a curve with hair-like marks (彡): bent, pliant things together, so 'soft, weak'. Another reading sees decorated bows that are weak in use. The modern form keeps the two halves, each like 弓 (bow) with two dots.
辶 (walk) for the meaning plus a sound part: in bronze script 朿 (thorn), later reshaped as 亦 (also). A trace or footprint; it also replaces 跡 (with 𧾷 foot).

译.def: to translate, to interpret; to encode, to decode

origin.says: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 睪 as the sound: to translate. Simplified from 譯, with 言 written 讠 and the sound part 睪 replaced by the simpler 𠬤.

译.name: translate

牌.def: card, game piece; placard, signboard, tablet

origin.says: 片 (slab of wood) for the meaning plus 卑 (lowly) as the sound: a wooden board with writing, a signboard, then a card or tile in games, and a brand.

牌.name: signboard

措.def: to arrange; to execute on; to manage

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 昔 (former times) as the sound: to place, to arrange, to handle.

措.name: arrange

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 良 (good) as the sound: a wave; by extension unrestrained, wasteful.

援.def: to assist; to lead; to quote, to cite

ety.hint: To lead 爰 by hand 扌; 爰 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 爰 as the sound. 爰 drew one hand passing a stick to another hand, pulling someone up, so it was probably the original of this word: to pull, to help.

援.name: pull up

ety.hint: Five 五 people 亻; 五 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 五 (five) as the sound and meaning: a squad of five soldiers, the ranks.

ety.hint: The logical order 仑 of human 亻 society; 仑 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: From 倫: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 侖 (ordered) as the sound: the proper order among people. 侖 was shortened to 仑.

徒.def: disciple, follower; only, merely; in vain

ety.hint: To walk 走 in someone's footsteps 彳

origin.says: Seal script had 辵 (walking) plus 土 (earth) as the sound: going on foot, a foot soldier, then a follower. The parts later turned into 彳 (step) + 走 (walk).

徒.name: follower

迷.def: to bewitch, to charm; a fan of; infatuated

origin.says: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 米 (rice) as the sound: walking and losing the way, hence lost, confused, and a fan who is lost in something.

迷.name: lost way

呈.def: to petition, to submit; to appear, to show

ety.hint: To speak 口 before a king 王

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 𡈼 (a man standing on the ground) as the sound: to present to a superior, to show. One reading sees speaking before a king; the bottom now looks like 王 (king).

呈.name: present up

悲.def: sorrow, sadness, grief; to be sorry

origin.says: 心 (heart) for the meaning plus 非 as the sound: a feeling of the heart, sorrow, grief.

悲.name: sorrow

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 耤 (to till) as the sound: records written on bamboo strips, registers.
Bronze forms have 比 (side by side, together) with 甘 (sweet) as the sound; the bottom later changed into 白 (white), so the sound part is no longer visible. Meaning: all, everyone.
Traditional 頁 draws a kneeling person with a big head, meaning 'head'; it was borrowed for 'leaf, page'. The simplified 页 is a cursive shortening of 頁.

页.name: page
页.in: 题领须项频预顾额顺顿烦顶倾颜颁硕颗颇颠顽顷颂濒颈颤颖嚣颊颓颅巅

贡.def: to offer, to contribute; tribute, gifts

origin.says: 工 (work) as the sound plus 贝 (shell, money) for the meaning: valuables offered up, tribute. Simplified from 貢, with 貝 (shell) in short form.

贡.name: tribute

映.def: to project; to reflect; to shine

origin.says: 日 (sun) for the meaning plus 央 (center) as the sound: light shining and casting an image, to reflect or project.

映.name: reflect

origin.says: 人 (person) as the sound with a line 一 (one) across it for a number: thousand. The person and the line now cross, so the shape is not split. It also stands in for 韆 in the word for swing.

毁.def: to damage, to ruin; to defame, to slander

ety.hint: A man using a tool 殳 to strike 工 a clay vessel 臼

origin.says: Bronze forms show 殳 (hand with a weapon) striking 兒 (child): to destroy, damage. The child's lower part became 土 (earth), and in the simplified form the left side reads as 臼 (mortar) over 工 (work). Other accounts take the left side as a sound part.

毁.name: smash

ety.hint: A house 广 made out of wood 木; 广 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: A variant of 牀, where 爿 was a bed drawn on its side plus 木 (wood). The variant put 广 (building) in its place: a wooden thing in the house, a bed.
甬 (bell) as the sound plus 力 (strength) for the meaning: strong and brave.

ety.hint: Simplified form of 漢; the Han 𦰩 river 氵

origin.says: From 漢: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus a sound part 𦰩-like (from 熯, to dry over fire). It named the Han River, then the Han dynasty and the Chinese. The simplification put 又 (hand) in place of the right side.

冒.def: to risk, to brave, to dare

origin.says: A hat (冃) over 目 (eye): the original form of 帽 (hat), meaning to cover; later to rush ahead covered, to brave, to risk, and to emit.

冒.name: brave risk

残.def: to injure, to ruin, to spoil; cruel, oppressive, savage; disabled, incomplete

origin.says: 歹 (bare bones, death) for the meaning plus 戋 (small) as the sound: to harm cruelly, hence ruined, disabled, incomplete. Simplified from 殘.

残.name: ruined

纳.def: to adopt, to accept; to receive, to take

origin.says: Simplified from 納: 糸 (silk, now 纟) for the meaning plus 内 (inside) as the sound, which also hints at taking in: to receive, to accept.

纳.name: accept

ety.hint: A crown 白 on the head of the emperor 王

origin.says: The top is a drawing of a plumed crown or headdress (now shaped like 白, white), with 王 (king) below, later read as the sound: the emperor.

挂.def: to suspend, to put up, to hang; suspense

origin.says: From 掛: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 卦 (divination figure) as the sound, to hang up. The simplified form drops 卜 and keeps only 圭 (jade tablet) as the sound.

挂.name: hang

摆.def: to arrange, to display; pendulum, swing

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 罢 (quit) as the sound: to set out, arrange, swing. Simplified from 擺 by simplifying 罷 to 罢.

摆.name: pendulum

聚.def: to assemble, to collect, to meet

ety.hint: People standing side-by-side 乑, hand-to-ear 取

origin.says: 取 (take) as the sound plus 乑 (three people) for the meaning: people coming together, 'to gather, to assemble'.

聚.name: assemble

origin.says: Oracle-bone forms are a cross, one stroke cutting through another: the original of 切 (cut). It was borrowed for the number seven, and 刀 (knife) was added to make 切 for the old meaning.
礻 (altar, spirits) added to 且 (ancestor tablet), which gives sound and sense: the ancestor.
A late character: 虫 (snake, creature) for the meaning plus 延 (prolong) as the sound, cut down to 疋 on top. It is a contracted form of 蜑, used for eggs, first said of snake eggs.

碍.def: to block, to deter, to hinder, to obstruct

origin.says: Replaces 礙 (石 stone plus 疑 doubt as the sound). The old variant 碍 is 石 (stone) plus 㝵, the ancient form of 得 (obtain): a rock in the way of getting something, to obstruct.

碍.name: obstruct

ety.hint: A stable 广 where carriages 车 are parked

origin.says: 广 (building) plus 车 (cart): a shed for carts, then any storehouse. One reading takes 車 (cart) as the sound only. Simplified from 庫 by writing 車 as 车.
A late character: 父 (father) plus 巴 as the sound, writing the spoken word for 'dad'.
口 (mouth) added to 觜 (an owl's tuft, a beak), which gives the sound and meaning: mouth, beak, spout.

ety.hint: Simplified form of 聖; a king 王 of listening 耳  and speaking口

origin.says: Stands for 聖 (ear + 呈 as the sound: one who hears, a sage). Simplification took over an older, separate character 圣, a hand 又 (hand) over 土 (earth), meaning 'to dig'.
Two strokes bending away from each other, showing something divided (later written 分). It was borrowed for the number eight because the words sounded alike.

八.name: eight
八.in: 分公只界港共织供识演商赛职积深份暴爆探松粉贫纷颁戴扮塞滚翼傻曝氛讼凌帜罕酸恭洪撰寒臀峻盼盆瀑颂扒殿哄俊叭竣吩橘芬陵掰巷趴

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 更 (change) as the sound: hard as stone, stiff, obstinate.
木 (wood) for the meaning plus 戒 (guard) as the sound: first wooden shackles, then tools and weapons.
米 (rice) for the meaning plus 分 (divide) as the sound, which also fits grinding into fine bits. It first meant rice ground into powder, used as face powder, hence powder and pink.

扰.def: to poke, to disturb, to annoy, to agitate

origin.says: Simplified from 擾: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus a complex sound part. The simplified form uses 尤 (especially) as the sound: to disturb or bother.

扰.name: disturb

origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 宗 (clan) as the sound: footprints, traces. It replaces 蹤, whose sound part 從 (follow) was swapped for the simpler 宗.
目 (eye) for the meaning plus 青 as the sound (perhaps also hinting at the clear, bright look): the pupil, the eyeball.

厌.def: to dislike, to detest; to reject; to satiate

origin.says: Simplified from 厭: 厂 (cliff) plus 猒 (a dog with meat, being full) as sound and meaning. Being sated became being fed up, to dislike. Simplification kept only 厂 and the 犬 (dog).

厌.name: fed up

忍.def: to endure, to bear, to suffer, to tolerate

ety.hint: A knife 刃 piercing the heart 心; 刃 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 心 (heart) for the meaning plus 刃 (blade) as the sound, with a fitting picture of a blade over the heart: to endure, to bear.

忍.name: endure

涨.def: flood tide; to rise in price

origin.says: Simplified from 漲: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 张 (to stretch) as the sound: water swelling, a rising tide; now also prices going up.

涨.name: rising tide

origin.says: 敏 (quick) as the sound plus 糸 (silk) for the meaning: first lush silk ornaments, hence many, abundant, complex.

疾.def: sickness, illness, disease; to envy, to hate

origin.says: Two words merged: 疒 (illness) and an old form showing an arrow 矢 (arrow) flying at a person, 'fast'. Hence both 'disease' and 'swift, urgent'.

疾.name: illness

ety.hint: Simplified form of 絲, two threads

origin.says: From 絲: two skeins of silk thread 糸 (silk) side by side. The simplified form comes from a cursive way of writing the pair.

弄.def: to do; to mock, to tease; to play with

ety.hint: Two hands 廾 playing with a piece of jade 玉; 廾 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 王 (here 玉, jade) over 廾 (two hands): hands playing with a piece of jade, hence to handle, to play with, to do.

弄.name: fiddle with

倍.def: to double; to increase or multiply

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 咅 (spit) as the sound. It first meant 'to turn one's back'; 'double, times' is a later use.
origin.src: Wiktionary; own knowledge for the first meaning

倍.name: double

origin.says: 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 竟 as the sound: early mirrors were polished bronze discs. Simplified from 鏡 by writing 金 (metal) in its short side form 钅.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 弗 (not) as the sound: first 'indistinct', then used to write the sound of 'Buddha'.

ety.hint: Money 贝 that must be split 分; 分 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 貧: 分 (to divide) as the sound over 貝 (money) for the meaning: wealth divided up until little is left, poor. 貝 is simplified to 贝.

姓.def: name, family name, surname; clan, people

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 生 (be born) as the sound, which also fits: the clan one is born into, traced through the mother, the family name.

姓.name: surname

ety.hint: A guard dog 犭 talking 讠 to a prisoner 犬

origin.says: From 獄: two dogs, 犭 and 犬, with 言 (words) between them, barking: a jail with guard dogs. 言 was shortened to 讠.

触.def: to butt, to gore, to ram; to touch

origin.says: Simplified from 觸: 角 (horn) for the meaning plus 蜀 (a caterpillar) as the sound, to butt with horns, to touch. The simplified form keeps only 虫 (worm) from 蜀.

触.name: touch

笔.def: pen, pencil, writing brush; to compose, to write; Hanzi stroke

ety.hint: A bamboo rod ⺮ tipped with hair 毛

origin.says: Traditional 筆 is 𥫗 (bamboo) plus 聿 (hand holding a brush) as sound and meaning. The simplified form, an old variant, replaces 聿 with 毛 (hair): brushes are bamboo tipped with hair.

笔.name: brush pen

origin.says: 耳 (ear) for the meaning plus 卯 (mortise; 4th branch) as the sound: first a ringing in the ears, then 'somewhat, merely'; today mostly 'to chat'.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus a shortened 盡 (exhaust) as the sound: a ford or ferry place, also body fluids. The sound part later turned into the look of 聿 (brush).

哭.def: to weep, to cry, to wail

ety.hint: To shed a tear from your eyes 口 over a person 犬

origin.says: 吅 (two mouths, loud crying) plus a long-haired person, a mourner: to wail, to weep. The person later warped into 犬 (dog); one reading takes 吅 as a sound part.

哭.name: weep

ety.hint: The top 一 of a tree 木

origin.says: A tree 木 (tree) with an extra stroke marking its top: the tip, and so the end, the last part, something trivial. Compare 本 (root), marked at the bottom.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 皮 (skin, surface) as the sound: the moving skin of water, waves.
谷 (valley) as the sound plus 欠 (open mouth, lacking) for the meaning: wanting what one lacks, desire. It also stands for 慾 (lust, with 心 heart).
Simplified from 猶: 犭 (dog, animal) for the meaning plus 酋 (chief) as the sound, first a kind of monkey; 'just like, still' is a sound loan. The simplified form puts 尤 (especially) for 酋.
